title: Inconsistent design system
intendedUserGoal: Understand repeated components as belonging to one coherent product system.

strongFindings.rootCause: Similar actions use inconsistent shape, shadow, and emphasis.
Repeated cards use inconsistent radius and elevation.

rootCauseObservations: Component drift is the issue; avoid treating each individual component as a separate defect.
mergeGuidance: Merge all button treatment drift into one finding and all card drift into one finding.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not create one finding per component instance.
